claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Acepromazine is a phenothiazine dopamine/alpha-adrenergic antagonist that at 2.5 uM is expected to produce little or no selective cytotoxicity, with any weak antiproliferative effect reflecting nonspecific cationic amphiphilic/lysosomotropic membrane perturbation rather than a targeted killing mechanism.
